# TaskFlow

> Collaborative task management with Jira-style boards, workspace roles, comments, attachments, and secure cookie sessions. Built with Next.js App Router and Express.

TaskFlow is a portfolio-grade SaaS app for teams that want a focused kanban board: columns, priorities, flags, keyboard-friendly drag and drop, task detail panels, workspaces, and member roles. Authentication uses httpOnly cookies through a Next.js backend-for-frontend; tokens are never stored in browser localStorage.

## Key facts

- Product name: TaskFlow
- Category: collaborative task management / kanban software
- Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Express 4, Prisma, Zod, Neon PostgreSQL or in-memory demo store
- Public site: /
- First-time guide: /guide
- Sign in: /login
- Demo owner: Syed Ali, syed.ali@taskflow.dev
- Structured data: WebSite, Organization, SoftwareApplication on /
- Crawler rules: /robots.txt
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
